text_block_list.text: North Flight mentioned she was going to do yoga with her friends, so I came to observe.
choice_data_list: By the way, why do yoga all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Understanding your body's proportions is important to knowing which outfits suit you best♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
We've got our "Sensei" with us, after all~.
So please, hit us with that model yoga to make us gorgeous to the max!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Calling me a 'teacher'?
I only really know the basics myself, you know."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, take a deep breath, everyone.
Focus on every muscle in your body... and breathe in—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: (Let's see... First, a muscle check. Assessing the materials that construct my body—)
Fu-chan, Fu-chan...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Hm? You are—

text_block_list.name: North Flight's Muscles
text_block_list.text: —I am your quadriceps. Thank you for always taking such good care of me.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: North Flight's Muscles
text_block_list.text: Ah! Keep breathing deeply! If yoga ends, their conversation will end too!

text_block_list.name: Gold City's Voice
text_block_list.text:
Yoga is a dialogue with your body—
Keep breathing, and focus on that conversation with yourself—

text_block_list.name: North Flight's Muscles
text_block_list.text:
...See? Yoga is a dialogue.
It's our special time to chat together!
So... let's keep talking, okay?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah!
It's such a rare opportunity, I have to make the most of it.
Deep breath, deep breath—

text_block_list.name: North Flight's Muscles
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Fuu-chan.
You really are kind, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Flight's Muscles
text_block_list.text:
"I'm the iliopsoas. Let's keep that core stable!
I'm the latissimus dorsi, pay more attention to me, please!
...Don't forget the transversus abdominis either."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm. Let's take turns talking. Could you tell me what everyone wants to say—?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa. Flight, you're crazy flexible!
You might actually have a talent for yoga, y'know?"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Really?
Then I guess I have my latissimus dorsi to thank.
The meaning behind that response remained a mystery, but after that, North Flight's body movements were sharper than ever!
